name: citeskill
description: Cite directly used agents, models, skills, plugins, apps, MCP servers, and projects in Git work.

interface.longDescription: Records direct agent, model, skill, plugin, app, MCP server, and project citations against commits and pull requests. Agent and model shares are optional user estimates; provider shares are derived from model estimates. Other sources are cited without percentages.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me record the direct agentic sources used in this repository with CiteSkill.
